fills.tieReason: s_00799 does show a clock of 10s, but Wallace's Rally (+50% infantry production speed) finished at t=585 ('Wallace's Rally completed', 12:53), before this 18:40 frame. The tooltip times change with that bonus. Pikeman shows 15s at t=454, before Rally, and Hardened Pikeman shows 10s at t=595 just after it. Cateran shows 10s at t=457 and 07s at t=627. So the 10s at t=799 is the Rally-boosted time, and the base train time is 10 x 1.5 = 15s, which is the same as the standard archer.
